action_items: No blocking issues. Iteration-5 backend + frontend acceptance criteria all met.

(Nit) The regenerate-summary endpoint writes `regenerated_at` to Mongo but DailyReport response model does not include the field, so callers never see the timestamp. Add `regenerated_at: Optional[str] = None` to DailyReport if the UI wants to show 'Regenerated at ...' (currently returns None even after a successful regen).
(Nit, carry-over) /app/backend/server.py is 1658 lines — still worth splitting into routers.
(Optional carry-over) Migrate deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` (or Platform.select) to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Recipient Groups list endpoint uses `current_user` (any authenticated user can list). Spec says 'Admin-only CRUD' — write access is properly gated to admin_only but READ is open. This matches the frontend requirement (RecipientGroupPicker needs to fetch the list for non-admin authors on Report Composer), so it is likely intentional; documenting for clarity.

server.py:1145 — `RecipientGroupCreate` `name` is validated but there is no uniqueness constraint. Two groups can share the same name, which could confuse the picker. Consider a unique index on (name).

server.py:1150 — regenerate-summary sets `tts_cache: None` and `regenerated_at`, but only `ai_summary` and `tts_cache` are declared in DailyReport, so `regenerated_at` is silently dropped by the response_model.

server.py:1173 — no rate-limit on regenerate-summary. Each call burns a GPT-5.4 credit; a mis-clicking user could spam it. Consider a 30s cooldown per report on the server or a debounced 'saving...' state in the UI.
